_doc: QUADRATIC BUDGET — every nested traversal of the repository, DECLARED with its class. SINGLE SOURCE, consumed by `test/quadratic-gate.test.js`. DETECTION is NOT here: it lives in `rules/no-undeclared-quadratic.yml` (ast-grep). Strict separation — the rule detects without exemption, this file plus its test carry the POLICY and the ratchet. Third twin of `temporal-budget.json` (TIME) and of the SPACE doctrine.
_doc_name: Named `quadratic`, never `complexity` alone: in this repository `budget.js` already means the EMISSION budget (characters per frame). Two different quantities must never share a word.
_doc_why: The target is a fleet of HUNDREDS of sites with THOUSANDS of pages. A scale defect does not slow anything down: it CLOSES A CONTRACT, and its retrofit is prohibitive, so it belongs to the SPEC and never to a later tuning pass. Ask before every loop: AND AT 10,000? — 5,000 elements compared pairwise is 12.5 million pairs. This gate exists because the rule lived in PROSE and prose refuses nothing: a quadratic write path was introduced into `src/memory-store-pure.js` and was caught by LUCK (two test cells timing out), not by a judge.
_doc_keys: A BUDGET KEY IS A RELATIVE PATH, NEVER A BASENAME. This repository holds several homonyms across `src/`, `src/sources/`, `src/hooks/`, `tools/` and `test/`: two of them melted into one key would make the red NON-ACTIONABLE — one would know there is one nesting too many without knowing in WHICH file. Paths use forward slashes on every OS.
_doc_baseline: 📐 BASELINE GENERATED BY MEASUREMENT OF THIS REPOSITORY ON 2026-08-21: 88 files, 352 nested traversals, over a perimeter of 168 tracked JavaScript files, all classed INHERITED_DEBT. The recipe is shared across the fleet; the NUMBERS are not. An imported figure would be an INVENTED ratchet, and an invented ratchet protects nothing. Until the baseline is generated, every file carrying a nested traversal is held at ZERO and the gate is RED, which is the correct fail-closed state for an ungenerated budget.
_doc_classes: CLOSED list. `O(N)` and `O(N log N)` = the inner traversal runs over a BOUNDED collection (a constant table, a fixed set of keys, a harness's parameter list): an act of instruction, so a written `why` is REQUIRED. `DEBT` = genuinely quadratic and knowingly kept: it owes a `why` AND a NUMERIC `impact`, because a budget measures QUANTITY and never GRAVITY — `N in debt` would put a benign nesting and a contract-closing one on the same line. `INHERITED_DEBT` = the measurement of the day, EXEMPT from justification ON PURPOSE: nobody has instructed those cases one by one, and demanding a sentence would produce INVENTED ones, which would then make the case look settled. A false justification is worse than none.
_doc_ratchet: The declared `max` must EQUAL the measured count. Measured ABOVE = a new nesting appeared: prove the class, or remove the nesting — 🛑 NEVER raise the `max` to make a push go through, that would be declaring the code has the right to get worse. Measured BELOW = a STALE declaration: LOWER IT in the same gesture, otherwise the ground gained is silently taken back by the next writer, who inherits the old ceiling. A file ABSENT from `files` is held at ZERO — that is what gives 100 % of the rule on all NEW code without first requiring the existing code to be repaired.
_doc_exit: EXIT CONDITION of the whole file: zero `INHERITED_DEBT` entry. Leaving a debt = inverted index / Map / Set, at PROVEN equivalence (property-based against the old code as oracle). 🛑 Never a probabilistic algorithm (LSH, MinHash, sampling): here a false negative has a client cost.

src/commit-msg-lang.js.why: The outer walk is over the LINES of ONE commit message and the inner traversal is a substring scan of ONE of those lines (`includes`/`startsWith` on the scissors marker). Total work is therefore the LENGTH OF THE MESSAGE, walked once, never a pair of lines compared: a message with twice the lines costs twice, not four times. Neither side grows with client volume — a fleet adds sites, it never adds lines to a commit message, and git itself bounds the buffer it hands over.

src/differential-normalize.js.why: The outer walk is over the FRAMES of ONE action and the inner one over the chunk headers of ONE frame body. Both are bounded by the wiring: an action declares 16 frames, and a frame carries at most a handful of chunk boundaries because its own capacity is ~7,661 characters. Neither side grows with client volume — a site adds pages, it never adds a frame to a tool call.

src/disk-writers-pure.js.why: The outer walk is over the files the scanner returned (the repository's runtime sources, 57 today) and the inner one over the METHODS met in ONE file, a handful. Neither side grows with the fleet: a client site adds pages, never a source file to this repository.

src/hooks/ctxroute-reset.js.why: PROMOTED OUT OF INHERITED_DEBT on 2026-08-23 rather than having its ceiling raised, because the nesting that arrived that day is the PreCompact sweep taking the cross-process lock. Three levels, and only the innermost grows: the outer walks the DISTINCT lock addresses of the five stores (two today, and the classes are a closed table in store-resolve.js), the middle walks the five declared store prefixes, and only the last walks the state directory. Both outer collections are constants of this framework, so the cost is LINEAR in the number of state files and can never become a pairwise comparison of two growing sets.

src/hooks/http-server.js.why: PROMOTED OUT OF INHERITED_DEBT on 2026-08-23 rather than having its ceiling raised. The purge route walks the DISTINCT lock addresses of the keys one compaction names (two today, a closed table in store-resolve.js) and, inside each, the keys of that class alone (five stores in total) — constant by constant, and the two loops exist precisely so no lock is ever taken inside another. The stale-code watcher walks require.cache, i.e. the modules THIS repository loaded, with constant work per entry; a client site adds pages, never a module here. Neither side is fed by client volume. ⚠️ LOWERED from 2 to 1 on 2026-08-24: `watchOwnCode` no longer derives the watched directories itself — that traversal moved to `stale-code-pure.watchedDirs`, which the watcher and the freshness check now share, because two spellings of one rule are two rules. The ratchet only ever goes DOWN.

src/model-twin-pure.js.why: Six of the seven nestings run over a BOUNDED inner collection (a constant token window of minTokens, one file import list, the models x judged sets held at 2 x 5 by the derivation floors, the permits of a single pair) and the tokenizer consumes each character exactly once, so it is amortised linear. The seventh, the maximal extension of a shared run inside the loop over index hits, is genuinely superlinear and is what this class declares.
src/model-twin-pure.js.impact: Worst case |A| x |B| token comparisons when a k-gram of minTokens tokens repeats across a file. MEASURED 2026-08-23 on the real perimeter: 7 pairs, files of 300 to 700 tokens, 34 runs found, whole measurement under 15 ms. It stays bounded because the perimeter is the models of ONE repository (2 today) and never a client corpus: at 100 models of 5000 tokens the pairing, not this loop, is the wall.

_doc_witnesses: ANTI-INERT, the guarantee that holds everything else. Every `kind:`/`pattern:` atom of `rules/no-undeclared-quadratic.yml` MUST be paired here with a line of code whose detection is REQUIRED (written to the OS tmpdir, scanned, detection asserted). An atom without a witness is REFUSED, so an atom added tomorrow stays RED until someone proves it sees anything at all. The tmpdir and not a folder of the repository: `ast-grep` HONOURS `.gitignore`, and witnesses written into an ignored folder are invisible (measured in this repository on 2026-08-06) — while a decoy written into `src/` or `test/` would make the arbo, doc-coverage and english-only gates go red AT RANDOM, since vitest runs suites in parallel. A gate must never make another gate flaky.
_doc_witness_shape: Every witness NESTS ITS ATOM INSIDE ITSELF, deliberately: that proves the atom both as the OUTER traversal and as the INNER one, and one broken atom then reddens EXACTLY one cell instead of drowning the whole table. A witness built as `atom inside a shared outer loop` would make every cell go red at once the day the outer atom broke, and an unreadable red is a red nobody acts on.

witnesses.for_statement: for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) { use(i, j); } }
witnesses.for_in_statement: for (const a of xs) { for (const b of ys) { use(a, b); } }
witnesses.$_IT.map($$$_A): const pairs = xs.map((a) => ys.map((b) => use(a, b)));
witnesses.$_IT.filter($$$_A): const kept = xs.filter((a) => ys.filter((b) => b === a).length > 0);
witnesses.$_IT.reduce($$$_A): const total = xs.reduce((acc, a) => acc + ys.reduce((s, b) => s + b, a), 0);
witnesses.$_IT.some($$$_A): const hit = xs.some((a) => ys.some((b) => b === a));
witnesses.$_IT.every($$$_A): const all = xs.every((a) => ys.every((b) => b === a));
witnesses.$_IT.find($$$_A): const found = xs.find((a) => ys.find((b) => b === a));
witnesses.$_IT.findIndex($$$_A): const at = xs.findIndex((a) => ys.findIndex((b) => b === a) >= 0);
witnesses.$_IT.findLast($$$_A): const last = xs.findLast((a) => ys.findLast((b) => b === a));
witnesses.$_IT.sort($$$_A): const ordered = xs.sort((a, b) => ys.sort((c, d) => c - d).length);

_doc_floors: ANTI-VACUITY — a gate that analyses nothing goes green, this repository's worst defect class (paid three times: `deps-purity`, `deadline-gate`, `layers-gate`). 🔴 AND THE MUTE SCAN IS NOT THEORETICAL: `ast-grep` returns an EMPTY JSON with EXIT CODE 0 when handed a path outside the project, so a MISRESOLVED PERIMETER IS INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM A PERFECTLY CLEAN REPOSITORY and the gate would be green FOR EVER. Hence a floor on the number of files handed to the scanner — never a floor on the number of FINDINGS, which would encode today's measurement as a second, inverted ratchet and would be wrong the day the repository is genuinely clean.
